name: Entry
note: cartridge entry point: nop; jp $176A

name: Boot
note: the entry jumps here

name: Call_HL
note: jp hl: a call to $0150 calls the routine at HL

name: Call_BC
note: push bc; ret: calls the routine at BC

name: Call_DE
note: push de; ret: calls the routine at DE

name: Far_Jump
note: one-way far jump: A = bank (hFF8B and $2100); jp hl

name: Far_Call
note: far call: B = bank; pushes the caller's bank; the callee returns through jp $0173

name: Far_CallKeepA
note: far call keeping A through hFF8A: B = bank; HL = target

name: Far_Return
note: pops the caller's bank; switches back; ret

name: Far_ReturnSramBank
note: return restoring a bank read from the stack (SRAM routines)

name: JumpTable_ByA
note: jump to word A of the table at HL

name: JumpTable_Inline
note: jump to word A of the table that follows the call

name: FarJumpTable_ByA
note: far call of record A of the {lo; hi; bank} table at HL through $015B

name: Mode_Set
note: mode = A (hFF8D)

name: State_Set
note: state = A (hFF8E)

name: ModeState_Set
note: mode = B; state = C

name: ModeState_SetInline
note: mode and state from the two bytes after the call

name: Copy_Inline
note: copy with inline {source; destination; count} after the call

name: Copy_DEtoHL
note: copy BC bytes from DE to HL

name: Copy_FarInline
note: copy with inline {source; bank; destination; count} after the call

name: Copy_FarDEtoHL
note: copy BC bytes from DE in bank A to HL

name: Lcd_SetupInline
note: 11 inline bytes: LCDC; BGP; OBP0; OBP1; SCY; SCX; WY; WX; -; STAT; IE

name: Lcd_SetupInlineNoIE
note: 10 inline bytes: the same without IE

name: Vram_CopyHBlank
note: copy BC bytes from DE to VRAM at HL in H-blank steps (current bank)

name: Vram_CopyHBlankFar
note: the same from bank A

name: Main_Loop
note: calls the mode routine of ModeTable through $01A0 every frame

name: Lcdc_SetCallbackNext
note: stores the LCDC-interrupt callback (DE) for the next frame (hFFA6/A7)

name: Lcdc_SetCallback
note: stores the LCDC-interrupt callback (DE) in hFFA4/A5

name: Serial_SetFarCallback
note: 3 inline bytes: a far callback {lo; hi; bank} stored in hFF97-99

name: Object_Create
note: object creation with BC = 0; falls into Object_CreateWithParam

name: Object_CreateWithParam
note: DE = descriptor in bank 2; BC = parameter; fills a 23-byte slot at $DAEE

name: Object_RunAll
note: the per-frame pass over the object slots (far-called from 00:1ACA; runs the slot routines at 00:2113 and 00:212F); code read

name: ScriptSlots_Clear
note: empties the 6 script slots of 20 bytes at $DC67 (the record book calls it on entry: BGB writes 01:5975/5976 at every visit)

name: ScriptSlots_Add
note: DE = {script; per-frame routine}: fills the first free slot of $DC67, script pointer at offsets 2-3

name: ScriptSlots_Run
note: runs one step of each busy slot of $DC67 (far called from banks 0 and 7)

name: RecordBook_CountHundreds
note: flowers of the first kind: the hundreds of the 4-digit BCD count in hFFEA-EB, 0-19, 20 from 2,000 on; 0 skips the kind

name: RecordBook_CountTens
note: flowers of the second kind: the tens digit of hFFEA

name: RecordBook_CountUnits
note: flowers of the third kind: the units digit of hFFEA

name: RecordBook_FlowerScript
note: slot script shared by the 5 vines: waits, then grows the hundreds, tens and units flowers one by one

name: RecordBook_GetTaken
note: hFFEA-EB = photos taken ($DAC9-DACA = SRAM $1000-$1001)

name: RecordBook_VineTaken
note: vine script of the taken counter (descriptor at 01:5732)

name: RecordBook_GetErased
note: hFFEA-EB = photos thrown away ($DACB-DACC = SRAM $1002-$1003)

name: RecordBook_VineErased
note: vine script of the thrown-away counter (descriptor at 01:574C)

name: RecordBook_GetExchangedX11
note: hFFEA-EB += 11 x photos exchanged ($DACD-DACE, BCD adds through $0CB4); BGB: 1 exchange shows 2 flowers (1 ten, 1 unit)

name: RecordBook_VineExchanged
note: vine script of the exchanged counter (descriptor at 01:5779)

name: RecordBook_GetReceivedX11
note: hFFEA-EB = 11 x (boys $DAD1 + girls $DAD2 received); BGB: 1 received shows 2 flowers

name: RecordBook_VineReceived
note: vine script of the received counter (descriptor at 01:57C1)

name: RecordBook_GetPrintedX6
note: hFFEA-EB += 6 x photos printed ($DACF-DAD0); BGB: 1 print shows 6 flowers

name: RecordBook_VinePrinted
note: vine script of the printed counter (descriptor at 01:57EE)

name: FactoryCheck_PutHexDigitVram
